t: Robust Forge Steel quick clamp 100mm (4") suitable for one-handed operation. Designed for rapid material securing, the durable steel frame clamp offers a powerful maximum clamping force of 1350kg/m², ensuring a secure hold on workpieces. The ergonomic non-slip plastic handle and smooth action allow for quick clamp and release with minimal hand effort. The one-handed speed clamp features a maximum jaw opening of 100mm, and is ideal for repetitive woodworking, metalworking, and general assembly tasks on-site or in the workshop. The top jaw can be angled for versatility on different surfaces, and the powder-coated finish provides added durability.
